notes.title: GotAD - BIG Comfy-Ween Update 1.1.0
notes.notes:
A massive autumnal themed update has arrived! Featuring:

Unnerving forest Fall themed terrain art
Spooky enemy reskins
Scary overcast effects
Terrifying scares
Wicked base HP raises at low levels for all characters
Sneering increases to base MP regen
Creepy Bot difficulty and pathfinding adjustments

NEW ALTERNATE CHARACTER COLORS

FAT RAT players can now find Candy dropped by bosses (in Arena and Dungeon) and sometimes stronger enemies in certain modes
The candy unlocks a new character skin for a randomly selected original character (the OG 16)
Players have these skins permanently!

Play with us Sunday evening around 9PM EST / 6PM PST and get SPOOKED!
https://discord.gg/dsNAkTx

Next up are some much needed server fixes, permanent servers, and a new trailer! Help us get some horrifying clips!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.9b - Crab Bucket Edition
notes.notes:
We got a play party brewing this Sunday at 9:15 EST/6:15 PST! You better show up bros and help me get some new trailer clips! Join the dang discord https://discord.gg/dsNAkTx !

... Did I say new trailer? BOY HOWDY I SURE DID! 
I got a BIG GotAD patch comin down the pipe for October, potentially including character skins, new fall themes, BETTER HOSTING FUNCTIONALITY, and always-on remote servers! Something that massive surely needs a new trailer to go along with it, no? Until then,

Enjoy some ultra fixes
• Truncated the levels of Knight Space ability charges - they're stronger early and require less charge
• Increased their mana costs to compensate
• Notesman Jam Aura is no longer cancelled by LMB, instead you can keep shooting with LMB while in it (albeit with a way decreased firerate)
• The Quintuple Encore spec now makes your firerate normal while in this state, as well as generally improving the MP aura effect
• Boomer turrents now follow your cursor, giving you the hint that they're player controlled
• Insaninator's Flaying Membrane's range increased
• Moonbushes now drop plums from 1 Moonmaster shot instead of 2
• Decreased Moon Beam aura MP cost
• Increased Bone Walker's crow bullet range
• Tweaked Bwizzard's Blizzard Aura to have a longer emit time
• Decreased Delight Knight's pastry drop time (from 3 seconds to 2.5 seconds)
• Made it so Gift Ghost's box will destroy with much less shots, and no longer destroys itself
• Nerfed 7 Trillion IQ Octopus

notes.title: PATCH 1.0.4 - Tiny Edition
notes.notes:
This week's patch brings fixes and balance tweaks, as well as a new gimmick mode and character auras!


Nerfed 7 Trillion IQ Octopus ball damage and firerate, and decreased Book size
Removed spawn protectors in Capture the Balloon mode, instead increased I-frames for freshly spawned players in the mode
Balloon drops properly when you die
You can now pick a random class at the beginning of the game
Fat Rat players can random into a Fat Rat class they have unlocked as they should've
Decreased Pontifficator Fountain firerate and bullet speed
Added a heart beat sound to play when below 20% HP
Base HP regen time cut from 30 seconds to 25 seconds (HP Necklaces adjusted accordingly)
Added on-equip aura affects for unique items!
Increased all player movespeed by 5%
New Fat Rat server setting - Tiny Mode: Players are half the size, 3% faster, and their FOV is halved


Join us and become TINY this Sunday @ 630 PST!
JOIN THE DISCORD! https://discord.gg/dsNAkTx

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes:
You don't de-tier in Dungeon mode anymore, once you get past level 10 or 20 you can't go below that level by dying unless you switch class
You now only lose 1 level from dying in Arena mode
Removed NPC Censorship Dialogue
Reduced arena close time after arena boss dies
Time between games is shorter
You'll just join a server if it's the only one available instead of going to browser
Typing bubbles appear over the heads of who are currently typing
Little objective reminders at certain level milestones
Drunk Munk bubble size increased
Bwizzard Blizzard snow speed increased
Metamancer Void Hole size increased
Base Night Knight Flail rotation speed increased
